items.title: UK to Give Saudi Arabia Defensive Support to Counter Houthis
items.original_title: UK to Give Saudi Arabia Defensive Support to Counter Houthis
items.rss_summary: The UK has agreed to support Saudi Arabia’s military in countering the Houthis, as the kingdom comes under frequent attack from the Iran-backed militants. Refueling of Saudi jets on missions that the UK considers defensive will begin in the coming days, and the operation is expected to last weeks.
